questions.question: Choose the word that best completes the sentence: The weather is very _____ today.
What is the opposite of 'happy'?
Which word means 'very big'?
What is the past tense of 'go'?
Choose the correct article: I have _____ apple.
Which sentence is correct?
What does 'quickly' mean?
Choose the correct form: The book _____ on the table.
What is the plural of 'child'?
Which word means 'to look at something carefully'?

title: اختبار القراءة والفهم
description: اختبار مهارات القراءة والفهم مع نصوص متنوعة

questions.question: Read the passage and answer: 'The library is a quiet place where people go to read books and study. It has many shelves filled with books on different subjects. Students often visit the library to do their homework and research.' What is the main purpose of a library?
Based on the same passage, who often visits the library?

Read: 'Climate change is affecting our planet in many ways. Rising temperatures are causing ice to melt, sea levels to rise, and weather patterns to change. We need to take action to protect our environment.' What is causing ice to melt?
What does the passage suggest we need to do?
options: Take action to protect our environment
questions.correctAnswer: Take action to protect our environment

questions.question: Read: 'Technology has changed the way we communicate. Instead of writing letters, we now send emails and text messages. Social media allows us to stay connected with friends and family around the world.' What has technology changed?
What allows us to stay connected with friends and family around the world?

Read: 'Education is important for everyone. It helps us learn new skills, understand the world around us, and make better decisions. A good education opens many doors and opportunities in life.' Why is education important?
options: It helps us learn new skills
It helps us understand the world
It helps us make better decisions

questions.question: What does a good education do?

title: اختبار القواعد المتقدمة
description: اختبار شامل لقواعد اللغة الإنجليزية المتقدمة

questions.question: Choose the correct conditional: If I _____ you, I would study harder.
Which sentence uses the passive voice correctly?
options: The book was written by the author.
The author was written the book.
The book written by the author.
questions.correctAnswer: The book was written by the author.

questions.question: Choose the correct reported speech: 'I will come tomorrow,' he said.
options: He said he will come tomorrow.
He said he would come tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: He said he would come tomorrow.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the present perfect correctly?
options: I have seen that movie yesterday.
I have seen that movie before.
questions.correctAnswer: I have seen that movie before.

questions.question: Choose the correct relative pronoun: The man _____ car was stolen called the police.
Which sentence uses the subjunctive mood correctly?
options: I suggest that he goes to the doctor.
I suggest that he go to the doctor.
I suggest that he went to the doctor.
I suggest that he going to the doctor.
questions.correctAnswer: I suggest that he go to the doctor.

questions.question: Choose the correct gerund: _____ English is not easy.
Which sentence uses the future perfect correctly?
options: I will finish my homework by 6 PM.
I will have finished my homework by 6 PM.
I finish my homework by 6 PM.
I finished my homework by 6 PM.
questions.correctAnswer: I will have finished my homework by 6 PM.

questions.question: Choose the correct modal verb: You _____ wear a seatbelt when driving.
Which sentence uses inversion correctly?
options: Never I have seen such a beautiful sunset.
Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
Never I seen such a beautiful sunset.
Never I see such a beautiful sunset.
questions.correctAnswer: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
